=== Consumables for a fight of 60 s: Damage ===
326.4 DPS without, 501.1 DPS with the set by value (+174.7, +53.5 %), 153g 91s per hour of fighting, to buy: 24g 78s
In buying order: what a step adds, what an hour of fighting costs more with it (a buff for the time it lasts, a potion in every fight), the gain per gold of that, then DPS and cost so far.
On you at the snapshot, so already in the numbers: Satt
